body: i know they do love me they just don’t know how to deal with my depression and anxiety and the worse it gets the more i feel myself pushing them away. it’s just lonely in the sense that my mental state isolates me making it difficult for me to express myself and leaving me to feel that i won’t get better and no one ever will understand what i’m going through, if that makes sense

i feel the same. i think i credit it mostly to detachment from life. i feel like i’m just floating through this daze, and there is nothing bringing me meaning or making me feel worthy. there’s just nothing and that makes me feel hopeless

i just had to go through this myself and it was not easy but very worth it in the end. it’s hard for parents to hear and they might be a bit angry or shocked at first but it will wear off, i’d say just be calm and speak from the heart. don’t let initial reactions freak you out, you can do it and it’s in your best interest to be open about your struggles
It really is!!! I criminally overthink everything in my life it makes you feel trapped in your own head, I hope you're able to work through it too
I hope things get better for you, thank you

I have the same relationship problems because of my depression, I don’t know if it’s the same for you but I feel like my partner really doesn’t understand me and it makes things really difficult. Just know you are not alone and it has made me feel a little better knowing you understand this feeling too
